name: Raise the Ancient Lizard-Gods
body:
School necromancy; Level druid 7

Components V, S, M, XP

Casting Time 1 day

Range Touch

Target One prehistoric, fossilized creature (up to 1HD per caster level)

Duration Permanent

Saving Throw None; Spell Resistance no

This mighty ritual animates the bones of a creature that has been in the earth for thousands or millions of years. The animated creature acquires the skeleton template. The creature obeys the commands of the caster.

Creatures created by this spell do not count against the number of undead you can create and control using animate dead.

Material Component: The skull and at least 20% of the bones of a prehistoric creature.

XP Cost: 2,000 XP
